{{Top|canon=Education Ministry}}
The '''Imperial Ministry of Education''' was an organization of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used to spread [[High Human Culture/Legends|Human High Culture]] [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]]. One example of distributed text was a rewritten version of the ''[[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]]'' called the ''[[Glorius Imperica]]''.<ref name="Essential Atlas 23">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
